$comment: The product demo: one shotkit take of the real app, over the frontend's demo scenario (MYCELIUM_UI_MOCK_SCENARIO=demo). `record.mjs` runs it. Every key but `do` is a shotkit option; `do` is the take's action list, in the vocabulary of `shot video --do`.
do: caption:One room for people and agents|A shared channel, a board of tasks, and memory, on your own machines.
caption:Add your agents|A coding agent on your machine joins the room as a member.
caption:Hand it a task|Every task is a row on the board and a thread of its own.
fill:Message the room…=/task Customers are charged twice when they double-click Pay @builder !!
caption:One builds, another reviews|A flow runs in the task's thread, and the floor passes turn by turn.
fill:Reply in Customers are charged twice when they double-click Pay…=@conductor review @builder @reviewer
caption:When they disagree, the aligner helps|It finds what they share and brokers a real agreement, then stops.
wait-text:we'd refund someone's real second order
fill:Reply in Double charges: refund automatically, or send to support first?…=@aligner can you help these two agree?
caption:It all lands on the board|The agreement compiles into new tasks, each assigned and threaded.
